name: goped-power-bot
description: Telegram Bot for Golestan Electricity Outage Schedules (GOPED)

scripts.cf:deploy: node -e "import('dotenv/config').then(async () => { const { spawnSync } = await import('child_process'); spawnSync('npx', ['wrangler', 'deploy'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: 'cf-worker', shell: true, env: process.env }); });"
scripts.cf:setup: node -e "import('dotenv/config').then(() => fetch('https://goped-power-bot.noterfanistio.workers.dev/setup').then(r => r.json()).then(d => console.log('Cloudflare Webhook Setup:', JSON.stringify(d, null, 2))));"
scripts.cf:status: node -e "import('dotenv/config').then(() => fetch('https://goped-power-bot.noterfanistio.workers.dev/info').then(r => r.json()).then(d => console.log('Bot & Webhook Status:', JSON.stringify(d, null, 2))));"
scripts.cf:logs: node -e "import('dotenv/config').then(async () => { const { spawnSync } = await import('child_process'); spawnSync('npx', ['wrangler', 'tail'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: 'cf-worker', shell: true, env: process.env }); });"
scripts.delete-webhook: node -e "import('dotenv/config').then(() => fetch('https://api.telegram.org/bot' + process.env.BOT_TOKEN + '/deleteWebhook?drop_pending_updates=true').then(r => r.json()).then(d => console.log('Webhook deleted:', d)));"
